conbody.p: By default, X-Author for Excel uses your system proxy settings. Because the system proxy settings are used to connect to your environment, the default configuration will work for X-Author in most cases. However, if your work environment is behind a firewall and you need to manually configure proxy authentication to connect to your environment, you must complete the procedure in this section.

note.p: System Proxy Settings are located at Settings > Network & Internet > Proxy.
